terms.title: Terms of service
terms.s1Body: Daam is an online marketplace where individuals and shops in Pakistan list phones for sale. Daam is not a party to any sale between a buyer and a seller.
terms.s2Body: You need a Pakistani mobile number to create an account, and each number can have one account. Keep your login secure; you are responsible for activity on your account.
terms.s3Body: Listings must describe a real phone you own or are allowed to sell, with an honest PTA status, condition and price. See the listing policy.
terms.s4Body: Daam does not handle payments between buyers and sellers. Never pay in advance. Paid promotions are optional, and a verification badge can never be bought.
terms.s5Body: We may review, hold, reject or remove listings, and suspend accounts that break these terms or the law.
terms.s6Body: Daam provides the platform as it is. Check every phone yourself before you pay.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.s1Body: Your phone number, profile details, listings and photos, messages sent through Daam, and basic usage data.
privacy.s2Body: IMEIs are encrypted and never shown publicly; buyers see only the last 4 digits. We use them to detect duplicate and stolen phones and for moderator PTA checks.
privacy.s3Body: Your number is never shown on public pages. Logged-in users can reveal it only if you allow calls or WhatsApp, and every reveal is logged and limited.
privacy.s4Body: CNIC and verification photos are stored privately, seen only by reviewing admins through short-lived links, and deleted 30 days after a decision. We keep only the decision and the last 4 digits of the CNIC.
privacy.s5Body: We remove location (GPS) and other hidden data from every uploaded photo.
privacy.s6Body: You can edit your profile, turn off WhatsApp or calls, and delete your account at any time.

listingPolicy.title: Listing policy
listingPolicy.intro: These rules keep Daam honest for buyers and fair for sellers.
listingPolicy.r1: Be one real phone, with your own photos.
listingPolicy.r2: State the PTA status and network lock honestly. CPID / patched phones must be disclosed and are never featured.
listingPolicy.r3: Include a valid IMEI. It stays private.
listingPolicy.r4: Include battery health for every used iPhone.
listingPolicy.r5: Show a real price in rupees.
listingPolicy.r6: Respect the limit: individuals can have up to 3 active listings. Sell more as a shop.
listingPolicy.p2: Replicas, copies and fake brand phones
listingPolicy.p3: Phones with a tampered IMEI listed as PTA approved
listingPolicy.p4: Tablets, watches and accessories (not supported yet)
listingPolicy.p5: Listings that ask for advance or token payment
listingPolicy.p6: Phone numbers or links in photos or descriptions

forShops.title: Daam for shops
forShops.intro: Bring your stock to buyers who already know what they want. Shops on Daam are verified, rated from real deals, and get their own storefront.
forShops.foundingBody: The first shops in Hafeez Centre and Hall Road get the top plan free for 6 months, a permanent Founding Shop badge, and help listing their stock.
forShops.v1: Owner CNIC and a live selfie
forShops.v2: Photos of the signboard and inside the shop
forShops.v3: Address and a Google Maps pin
forShops.verifyNote: Verification badges can never be bought. Every check must pass.

reportStolen.title: Report a stolen phone
reportStolen.intro: If your phone was stolen, add its IMEI to Daam's stolen-phone registry. Any listing with that IMEI is held for review.
reportStolen.imeiHelp: 15 digits, printed on the box or the purchase receipt.
reportStolen.privacyNote: We store only a secure hash of the IMEI and its last 4 digits.
reportStolen.sent: Report received. Matching listings will be held for review.
